gen-righteous-gf-anek-telugu: Chunky, playful rounds up top, built like bent steel rod. Righteous is the loud one that fills its line, while Anek Telugu quietly carries the reading with wide, tall bowls.
gen-righteous-gf-anuphan: Anuphan reads with big round lowercase bowls and open curves that leave clear gaps inside. And Righteous above it keeps its joints smooth where strokes meet, so the sans-serif body feels like a softer echo.
gen-righteous-gf-arimo: Commanding is how Righteous looks, its flat, single-weight linework filling each line with bold bowls. Arimo takes over for the reading, with a tall mean line and spacious gaps in its rounded glyphs.
gen-righteous-gf-armata: Contemporary in feel, Armata gives the body generous gaps between characters and lowercase that fills most of the letter height, all under Righteous with its vinyl-cut sign lettering. Shrink the heading and that punch fades fast.
gen-righteous-gf-athiti: Sign-shop swagger up top, then a friendlier voice below. Righteous bends its bowls to fill the line, and Athiti follows with a high mean line and a see-through gap in each s, making a long read easy.
gen-righteous-gf-atkinson-hyperlegible: Fun, forceful lettering drawn as if with a fixed pen. And Atkinson Hyperlegible keeps the reading easygoing, its wide-set s terminals and clipped capitals making Righteous feel even bolder above.
gen-righteous-gf-atkinson-hyperlegible-m: Atkinson Hyperlegible Mono spaces its letters far apart. Righteous does best with big, smooth bowls and no swelling at the stem joins, while the mono body is built for open counters that breathe into the white space.
gen-righteous-gf-biryani: Loud, bendy bowls fill the headline like steel rod. Biryani follows with a large clear eye on every e and no thick-and-thin shifts, so a long read stays unclogged.
gen-righteous-gf-blinker: Approachable, that's Blinker, with open apertures and lowercase filling most of its height. Its strongest quality is how lines hold their thickness beside Righteous, a display face with steel-rod bowls.
gen-righteous-gf-carrois-gothic: Modern and professional, Carrois Gothic brings a high-set x-height and a generous opening in c beneath Righteous. And its stroke edges stay parallel through every curve, so a longer read moves along smoothly.
